canonical_project: National Data Centre, Blantyre (secondary/backup national DC)
notes: National Data Centre in Blantyre commissioned 21-22 Jul 2022 (Xinhua official wire, President Chakwera), Huawei-built, hosts government-wide systems; DIGMAP (2024) designates Blantyre as Secondary/Backup to the Lilongwe Primary DC. ML.mw blog (B/C) describes it as Tier 3 by Huawei with ESCOM involvement. No MW capacity or certification detail publicly disclosed; datacentermap.com lists it as the country's sole listed facility.
